table.retrieve:
SELECT 	
	manf=Manufacturer.name,
	manfcatname=manufacturercategory.name,
	Item.Name,  
	aliasname=item.customicode, 
	active=CASE item.active WHEN 1 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END,
	PurPrice = Case When (isnull(sum(cast(GodownDetail.CurrQty as int)),0) % Item.PackUnits ) = 0 THEN Item.PurPrice Else Round(Item.PurPrice/Item.PackUnits,2) End, 
	SalePrice = Case When (isnull(sum(CAST(GodownDetail.CurrQty AS INT)),0) % Item.PackUnits ) = 0 THEN Item.SalePrice Else Round(Item.SalePrice/Item.PackUnits,2) End, 
	Item.PackUnits,
	serverdate=getdate() ,   
	QTY = isnull(sum(GodownDetail.CurrQty),0),  
	PackQty =convert(int,isnull( Round(sum(GodownDetail.CurrQty) / CASE WHEN Item.PackUnits > 0 THEN Item.PackUnits ELSE 1 END, 2),0)),
	looseqqty=isnull( Round(sum(CAST(GodownDetail.CurrQty AS INT)) % Item.packUnits, 2),0)
FROM 	
	Manufacturer,
	manufacturercategory  , 
	Item
	LEFT OUTER JOIN GodownDetail ON (Item.ICode = GodownDetail.ICode)
	
WHERE 
	manufacturercategory.manfcatcode in (:ai_manfcatcode) and
	manufacturercategory.manfcatcode=Manufacturer.manfcatcode and
	Manufacturer.manfcode = Item.ManfCode and
	Item.active=1 
GROUP BY 
	manufacturercategory.name,
	Manufacturer.name,
	Item.name,
	item.customicode, 
	Item.Active, 
	Item.purprice, 
	Item.SalePrice, 
	Item.PackUnits
ORDER BY 
	manufacturercategory.name,
	Manufacturer.name,
	Item.name
table.sort: manfcatname A, manf A, itemname A
